title: Catch the Star
description: SUPER DUPER HARD star catching! Only 3 hearts, a tiny basket, and stars that fall faster and faster. Rare power-ups might save you.

title: Jaw Breaker
description: Smash candy bricks! Catch power-ups, light the ball on fire, and hunt for the rainbow brick, spend your coins in the power-up store, and survive 100 levels and beat a boss every 10 levels for 5 bonus hearts.

title: JAW BATTLE
description: Shoot it out with a sneaky bot! Duels, 2v2 to 4v4 team battles, Capture the Flag, 500 autumn maps, 9 guns with fire and ice perks, skins with real powers, a freezing secret gun, teleports, bots that dig underground, a practice range, and phone controls!

title: NEWS
description: Read The Daily Jaw, a silly fake newspaper with made-up stories, secret codes, and reader letters!
